result.stdout:
heddle — render a Heddle template against a JSON model (T4-successor codegen).

Usage:
  heddle render <template> [--model-json <file>] [--out <file>] [--root <dir>]

Options:
  --model-json <file>  JSON file whose object is the template model (objects -> members,
                       arrays -> @list/@for, scalars -> primitives). Omit for a model-less template.
  --out <file>         Write output to this file instead of stdout.
  --root <dir>         Resolver root for @partial/@<< imports (default: the template's directory).
